verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song. Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.

xrefs.text: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.
Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God; let all the neighboring lands bring tribute to Him who is to be feared.
I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.
Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.

Additionally, David and the commanders of the army set apart some of the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to prophesy with the accompaniment of lyres, harps, and cymbals. The following is the list of the men who performed this service:

verses.text: O You who listen to prayer, all people will come to You.

xrefs.text: Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
Even before they call, I will answer, and while they are still speaking, I will hear.
And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
From one New Moon to another and from one Sabbath to another, all mankind will come to worship before Me,” says the LORD.
All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.

verses.text: When iniquities prevail against me, You atone for our transgressions.

xrefs.text: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.
And with it he touched my mouth and said: “Now that this has touched your lips, your iniquity is removed and your sin is atoned for.”
Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.
But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself unblemished to God, purify our consciences from works of death, so that we may serve the living God!

verses.text: Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.

xrefs.text: For He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless in His presence. In love
How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah
Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,
Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.

verses.text: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.

xrefs.text: He is your praise and He is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome wonders that your eyes have seen.
Turn to Me and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!
Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You.
In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.

verses.text: You formed the mountains by Your power, having girded Yourself with might.

xrefs.text: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations; the ancient mountains crumbled; the perpetual hills collapsed. His ways are everlasting.
Hear, O mountains, the LORD’s indictment, you enduring foundations of the earth. For the LORD has a case against His people, and He will argue it against Israel:
Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.
The bows of the mighty are broken, but the feeble are equipped with strength.

verses.text: You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.

xrefs.text: You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.
The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.
Alas, the tumult of many peoples; they rage like the roaring seas and clamoring nations; they rumble like the crashing of mighty waters.
When Jesus said, “I am He, they drew back and fell to the ground.
He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.

verses.text: Those who live far away fear Your wonders; You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.

xrefs.text: Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.
You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
the sun to rule the day, His loving devotion endures forever.

When you look to the heavens and see the sun and moon and stars— all the host of heaven— do not be enticed to bow down and worship what the LORD your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.
The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.

verses.text: You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.

xrefs.text: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
He waters the mountains from His chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.
They have not said in their hearts, ‘Let us fear the LORD our God, who gives the rains, both autumn and spring, in season, who keeps for us the appointed weeks of harvest.’
You sent abundant rain, O God; You refreshed Your weary inheritance.

verses.text: You soak its furrows and level its ridges; You soften it with showers and bless its growth.

xrefs.text: I planted the seed and Apollos watered it, but God made it grow.
who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow on the hills.
Let my teaching fall like rain and my speech settle like dew, like gentle rain on new grass, like showers on tender plants.

verses.text: You crown the year with Your bounty, and Your paths overflow with plenty.

xrefs.text: Do not be afraid, O land; rejoice and be glad, for the LORD has done great things.
who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,
For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.
They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.
Is there still seed in the barn? The vine, the fig, the pomegranate, and the olive tree have not yet yielded fruit. But from this day on, I will bless you.”

verses.text: The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.

xrefs.text: to bring rain on a barren land, on a desert where no man lives,
Do not be afraid, O beasts of the field, for the open pastures have turned green, the trees bear their fruit, and the fig tree and vine yield their best.
He sends forth springs in the valleys; they flow between the mountains.
You formed the mountains by Your power, having girded Yourself with might.

I will rejoice greatly in the LORD, my soul will exult in my God; for He has clothed me with garments of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom wears a priestly headdress, as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

verses.text: The pastures are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are decked with grain. They shout in triumph; indeed, they sing.

xrefs.text: You will indeed go out with joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.
The wilderness and the dry land will be glad; the desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
Yet He has not left Himself without testimony to His goodness: He gives you rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, filling your hearts with food and gladness.
Then He will send rain for the seed that you have sown in the ground, and the food that comes from your land will be rich and plentiful. On that day your cattle will graze in open pastures.
Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.
